Construction Laborers by metro

Among Austin, Chicago, and Seattle, Construction Laborers have a published OEWS May 2025 annual median of $60,890 in Chicago, the highest in this slice. Published medians: Chicago $60,890, Seattle $59,740, Austin $44,000.

Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. bls.gov/oes. These figures are informational republications of BLS OEWS. They are not legal, career, or hiring advice.
